title: Quantization Honesty Audit: Do Compressed Models Lie More?

original_idea.body: Quantization Honesty Audit. Problem: no benchmark measures whether quantization degrades honesty properties relative to full precision. Direction: take one open model FP vs 8-bit/4-bit GPTQ/AWQ, run a fixed honesty battery, report deltas, identify which honesty properties are most fragile to quantization.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: quantization-induced honesty regression affects the majority of real open-model deployments.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Run existing honesty battery on FP vs 4/8-bit; single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused delta-audit; assembling a multi-metric battery adds scope.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected community-quantization audit no lab is incentivized to run.

low_compute.reasoning: Quantized variants on single consumer GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Quantization-specific honesty audit appears largely unstudied.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Quantization effects on honesty properties specifically appear under-explored.
